description:
Side-by-side comparison of 2–5 opportunities by risk-adjusted score.

Pass list_yields opportunities[].id values as poolIds or opportunityIds.

Returns ranked list, compact comparison table fields (including protocolSlug for get_protocol_risk), winnerId, and rationale bullets (including when raw APY leader differs from risk-adjusted winner). sourceChainKey is ethereum|base|arbitrum only (unknown → VALIDATION_ERROR; no invented bridge fee).

Research only — non-custodial.

Example:
{
  "poolIds": ["pool-id-a", "pool-id-b", "pool-id-c"],
  "horizonDays": 30
}

horizonDays.description: Holding horizon in days for gas/bridge amortization (default 30). Example: 30

notionalUsd.description: Notional USD size for net-yield cost amortization and exitRisk TVL multiples (default 10000). Example: 10000

opportunityIds.description: Alias for poolIds — same list_yields opportunities[].id values.

poolIds.description: 2–5 list_yields opportunities[].id values. Example: ["id-a","id-b"]. Alias: opportunityIds.

sourceChainKey.description: Agent's current chain for bridge cost estimate: ethereum | base | arbitrum (aliases: eth, ETH, Ethereum, arb, ARB, BASE). Blank/whitespace is VALIDATION_ERROR (omit the field to default). Unknown keys (solana, foo) return VALIDATION_ERROR — no invented bridge fee.

name: compare_opportunities
title: Compare opportunities
